enchantments.tooltip: Fascination Guard: The brilliance of this item tends to distract enemies. When hit or missed in melee combat, your foes have a chance to be Fascinated with no save.
False Life +18: +18 Enhancement bonus to hit points.
Sonic Absorption +18%: Passive: 18% Enhancement Bonus to Sonic Absorption. (Absorption reduces damage from an element by a percentage, after resistance have been taken into account.)
Freedom of Movement: This item grants its wearer the ability to move and attack normally while under the influence of magic that impedes movement, such as paralysis, solid fog, slow and web.
